data.one_liner: An Instagram-style pinch and zoom widget that appears globally via an OverlayEntry.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ZoomOverlay widget that lets users pinch, zoom, and drag any child widget so that it appears on top of all other elements on the screen. It animates back to its original position when the zoom stops.
use_when: You want Instagram-style pinch and zoom functionality for images or widgets.
You need zoomed content to render on top of all other widgets using an overlay.
You want a pure Dart implementation supporting all Flutter platforms.
avoid_when: You need complex map navigation or photo gallery viewgers with multi-image swiping built-in.
You need state management or routing features.
strengths: Appears on top of other widgets by using an OverlayEntry.
Pure Dart implementation compatible with all Flutter platforms.
Customizable animation curve, duration, scale limits, and modal barrier color.
weaknesses: Limited to single widget overlay zooming rather than a full photo viewer experience.
Does not document advanced multi-touch pan/zoom gestures beyond basic scaling.
data.minimal_example:
ZoomOverlay(
    minScale: 0.5,
    maxScale: 3.0,
    child: CachedNetworkImage(
        imageUrl: imageUrl,
    ),
)
